EvidenceIndicators.description:
The three evidence indicators, the composite strength, and any extras.

``details`` extends the contract without changing the four original fields:
each entry is a full :class:`EvidenceIndicator` for a signal computed
beyond ``configs/config.yaml`` (rating-distribution entropy,
helpfulness-weighted sentiment, ...), so new signals need no schema change.
A name may appear only once in ``details`` and may not shadow
:data:`FIXED_INDICATOR_NAMES`; both violations are rejected because
clients key indicators by name.

verified_purchase.description: Share of the product's reviews that are verified purchases.

details.description: Additional evidence signals computed beyond the three fixed indicators, each with a 0-1 value, its raw value, direction and a plain-language description; empty when no extra signals were computed. Names are unique within this list and never reuse the fixed keys ('verified_purchase', 'helpfulness_ratio', 'review_depth').

FuzzyAssessment.description:
The fuzzy stage: memberships, fired rules, output degrees, crisp output.

``output_degrees`` is keyed by the fuzzy output terms from
``configs/fuzzy_rules.yaml`` - currently ``low``, ``moderate``, ``high`` and
``critical`` - and each value is that term's aggregated firing degree (0-1).
``defuzzified`` is the crisp value on the fuzzy output scale (0-100), which is
what TOPSIS receives as its extra cost criterion.

details.description: Shannon entropy of the star distribution normalised by log(5) (0 = one shared star, 1 = perfectly spread): 0.9173 here over the 19/4/14/7/8 star split, so opinions span all five stars and the 2.63 mean hides a divided audience.
details.name: rating_distribution_entropy

details.description: Weak labels (0 negative, 1 neutral, 2 positive) averaged with each review's helpful votes as weight and rescaled to 0-1 (raw 0-2 mean label 1.1034): 0.5517 here from 29 helpful votes across 52 reviews, above the 0.4231 unweighted value - the reviews shoppers voted useful read better than average.

details.description: Share of the weak-negative reviews that are one-star reviews (19 of 23 here): negative feedback packed into the harshest bucket rather than spread over 2-3 stars.
details.name: negative_severity_share

helpfulness.description: Share of reviews that at least one other shopper found helpful (8 of 52 here); the raw value is the mean helpful-vote count per review.
helpfulness.name: helpfulness_ratio

review_depth.description: How substantive the review text is, from the mean character length of the reviews (206.31 characters here).
review_depth.name: review_depth

verified_purchase.description: Share of the product's reviews that are verified purchases (49 of 52 here).
verified_purchase.name: verified_purchase

reasons.text: 23 of 52 reviews (44.2%) carry the weak negative label, the largest single driver of the risk score.
49 of 52 reviews (94.2%) are verified purchases, which lowers the risk score.
